definitions.full: H2777. charsuth חרסות Kt, חַרְסִית Qr noun feminine collective potsherd — הַחַרְסִ֯ות שַׁעַר מֶּתַח Jer 19:2 , designation of a gate in Jerusalem; opening of the gate of potsherds , i.e. where they were thrown (see 19:10 ; 19:11 and Gf); it led into the valley of Hinnom; ᵐ5 Ξαρς ( ε ) ιθ favours Qr **see Baldensperger PEF 1904, 136 on the crushing of potsherds in the Valley of Hinnom.
